import statistics, math
vals=[6.574,6.834,6.903,6.950,6.924]
changes=[b-a for a,b in zip(vals,vals[1:])]
sigma=statistics.stdev(changes)
print('values', vals)
print('changes', changes)
print('mean_change', statistics.mean(changes))
print('sample_sigma', sigma)
print('half80', 1.28*sigma)
print('point_persistence', vals[-1])
print('ci', vals[-1]-1.28*sigma, vals[-1]+1.28*sigma)
print('trend_point', vals[-1]+statistics.mean(changes))
